row.notes: Clears then fills out_vec (elements 0x6780 bytes, built by Game_SceneSpawnParams_CopyConstruct, torn down via Game_CustomisationSet_Dtor on +0x11D0 step 0x4A50 with count +0x5C20). Collects team handles from 0x88-byte entries (+0x5C team handle, +0x50 driver handle, +0x60 vehicle handle, 0x3fff=none) of either single_entry_list (+0x10..+0x18) or every list under entry_lists (+0x10 array, count +0x70, each +0x130 sub-lists count +0x230), and vehicle handles from those entries or from entrants_system+0x358 table (+0x4B0). For each team resolved with Sess_ResolveEntityHandle it emits one spawn param per matching vehicle (vehicle +0x15E/+0x160 team, +0x152 driver, +0x158 optional) carrying driver slot byte entry+0x83 and flag +0x80/+0x81, or a team-only param with the first entry whose +0x81 is set and +0x80 clear; self+0x88 ->+0x260 ->+0xE68==1 is passed as a mode flag. Hook to change which cars/drivers appear in team-select and fan-zone scenes.
